summary: First iteration testing of Logistiki Pro (Greek law firm accounting MVP). Backend: 17/17 pytest passed covering auth, clients, invoices (totals + mock myDATA issue), expenses (+OCR endpoint reachable), payroll (EFKA rates verified), dashboard summary, settings, myDATA status, tax calendar, logout. Confirmed all responses use 'id' key (no '_id' leakage). Confirmed real AI OCR flow works end-to-end using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + gpt-5.4-mini via a generated PNG receipt (returned correct vendor/date/amount/vat_amount/vat_rate/category JSON). Frontend: login, dashboard KPIs, chart, disclaimer, sidebar navigation to Clients/Invoices/Expenses/VAT/myDATA/Payroll/TaxCalendar/Settings all render, all required data-testids present, logout redirects to /login and unauth /auth/me returns 401.

minor.issue: Fails with confusing 500 message when a non-standard/corrupted JPEG is uploaded (litellm rejects it as unsupported format). Consider validating image format & returning a friendly 400.

console_warnings.issue: useEffect passed an async function directly (useEffect(load, []) where load is async). React logs: 'useEffect must not return anything besides a function'. Also triggers React error-boundary warning on those pages. Wrap in an inner async function: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []).

action_items: Fix useEffect(async load, []) pattern in Clients.jsx (L23) and Expenses.jsx (L32) - wrap async call inside a sync callback.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the admin credentials (admin@logistiki.gr / Admin@2026!) - file currently only has boilerplate header, no actual creds recorded.
(Nice-to-have) Add friendly 400 response on /api/expenses/ocr-parse when image bytes aren't a valid png/jpeg/gif/webp instead of surfacing the litellm 500.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' with secure=True - correct for cross-site cookie between frontend & backend; ensure production origin uses HTTPS (it does).

routes_dashboard.py mutates recent_invoices/expenses to add stringified _id but the response still contains '_id' key alongside no 'id' - if the frontend expects 'id' on these lists it may silently fail. Consider mapping to 'id' for consistency with the rest of the API.
seed_admin correctly rehashes when password mismatch detected (updates existing admin) - good.
MongoDB _id serialization is correctly handled globally via BaseDocument.from_mongo mapping to 'id' - verified across clients/invoices/expenses/payroll/settings responses.
myDATA issue flow correctly labels result as MOCK (prefixes MARK/UID with 'MOCK-'/'UID-') and /api/mydata/status returns explanatory Greek 'note' field confirming mock mode.
Payroll rates verified: 13.87% employee, 22.29% employer EFKA, progressive tax brackets applied over 14 salary annualization.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (all pages load, all key data-testids present, login/logout OK)

test_credentials: admin@logistiki.gr / Admin@2026! (verified working). NOTE: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is essentially empty (only boilerplate) - main agent should record credentials there.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed clients, employees, and one invoice/expense; no cleanup performed but non-destructive to seeded admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + AI OCR verified end-to-end (real gpt-5.4-mini call succeeded on a PIL-generated PNG receipt). Voice-parse endpoint was NOT tested with real audio (no sample .webm) - would need a real spoken Greek audio file; endpoint code path is sound (Whisper -> LLM -> client match). All /api endpoints return 'id' not '_id'. myDATA sync is MOCK by design (per user's Phase 1 spec). Frontend has minor console warnings about useEffect(async fn) in Clients & Expenses that trigger a React error-boundary warning but do not break rendering.
